operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Corresponds to nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=3, num_channels=3, eps=1e-05, affine=True).forward(x).
Input x has shape (N, C, H, W); num_groups must divide C (here C=3 and num_groups=3, so one group per channel).
For each sample n and group g (which contains exactly one channel c=g): compute mean and variance over all spatial positions (H*W elements) using biased variance (divide by H*W).
Normalize each element: y[n,c,h,w] = (x[n,c,h,w] - mean[n,c]) / sqrt(var[n,c] + eps).
If weight is not None and bias is not None, apply affine per channel: y = y * weight[c] + bias[c]. If weight or bias is None, omit the corresponding term.
Output shape is identical to x's shape and dtype is torch.float32 on CUDA.
The reference uses weight and bias from state dict, both non-None in this task.
The operator must handle non-contiguous input by using strides or internally making contiguous copy; output must have same shape.
Computes GroupNorm normalization and optional affine transform as described.
The result is a CUDA tensor of shape (512, 3, 384, 384), float32, with stride matching input (contiguous).
